postit.1.texto: Lucas Frois Vasconcellos. I build websites, automations and tools, always with AI as my coding partner.
postit.2.texto: I spent a year writing JavaScript scripts for Tribal Wars. The biggest one became an operation planner, with a canvas map and target distribution.
postit.3.texto: JavaScript · HTML & CSS · Python · SQL (MySQL) · Google Sheets · Three.js · Git
postit.4.texto: I studied Computer Science at UFSCar and I'm moving toward data science. Away from the screen, I captain a handball team: check the back wall.

leiame.como.texto: The room is made of illustrations of the walls of my real bedroom, generated with AI and assembled in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. The monitor and laptop screens are real HTML placed over the drawing. The medals use Three.js. The code was written with help from Claude.
leiame.creditos.vazio: The handball photos and their credits arrive in the final version.
leiame.privacidade.texto: This site uses no cookies and asks for none of your data. Cloudflare receives your IP address to deliver the pages. When you open the GitHub app, GitHub receives your IP to answer the request. Visit counting (Umami, with servers in the United States and the European Union) receives only the page viewed and the names of clicks, without identifying you. Your language, whether you've seen the tour and a copy of GitHub's public data are stored only on your device. The message written in the laptop's WhatsApp only leaves your device when you confirm sending it, and it goes straight to WhatsApp.
leiame.marcas.texto: GitHub, WhatsApp, Instagram and LinkedIn appear only to say where each button leads. This site is not affiliated with those companies. The screens of those services are simulations, and the icons are original drawings.
